hard_rule: This is a review matrix, not a tax advice engine.
policy: Every row is status=under_review, legal_verified=false, active=false, accountant_review_required=true. possible_rate and tax_base are populated ONLY where archived official bytes support them; otherwise null or 'needs_reviewer'. A row is a prompt for a human, never an instruction to the product. Nothing here may be wired into AI Invoice Review, and nothing here may be written to tax_rules with status='active'.
precedence: raw_sources/ + MANIFEST.json SHA-256 is authoritative. summaries/_extracted/ is derived review text and never a source of truth. source_ids name registry sources, never derived files.

matrix.label: Rent
missing_data_questions: Is the tenant a Pemotong under PP 34/2017 Pasal 3(2)?
Does the invoice include charges billed by a THIRD PARTY rather than the landlord?
Is any part of this lodging/accommodation (excluded from the final regime)?
matrix.notes: Rate and base cited to PP 34/2017 Pasal 4(1)-(2) read from archived bytes. FINAL tax — not a creditable withholding; do not model as a simple deduction.

matrix.label: Service fee
missing_data_questions: Is the supplier an ENTITY (badan) or an individual? Individual may be PPh 21, not PPh 23.
Does the supplier have an NPWP? (uplift may apply)
Which enumerated jasa lain item does this service fall under?
matrix.notes: Rate and base cited to PMK 141/PMK.03/2015 Pasal 1(1) read from archived bytes: '2% dari jumlah bruto tidak termasuk Pajak Pertambahan Nilai'. Whether PMK 141/2015 is still current is UNCONFIRMED.

matrix.label: Management service
missing_data_questions: Who pays whom? Landlord->third party differs from tenant->landlord.
Is this billed as part of rent by the landlord (then PPh 4(2)) or separately by a manager (then PPh 23)?
matrix.notes: DJP_PPH42_006 states third-party building services are jasa manajemen at 2% under Pasal 23. But PP 34/2017 Pasal 4(2) puts service charges billed BY THE LANDLORD inside the rental base. The boundary is 'who pays whom' on our reading — that reading is NOT stated by either instrument and needs a reviewer.

matrix.label: Building service / service charge
missing_data_questions: Is this charge billed by the landlord or by a separate manager?
Is it contracted separately from the lease?
Does the tenant pay the manager directly?
matrix.notes: DELIBERATELY AMBIGUOUS. PP 34/2017 Pasal 4(2) says a service charge relating to the rented property is in the rental gross even if separately contracted; DJP_PPH42_006 says third-party building services are PPh 23. Both are archived and read. The engine MUST NOT pick one — route to accountant review.

matrix.label: Contractor / freelancer
missing_data_questions: Is the provider an individual (PPh 21) or an entity (PPh 23)?
If an entity, which jasa lain item applies?
matrix.notes: rate deliberately null: the article depends on the provider's legal form, which our data cannot determine.

matrix.label: Salary / payroll
missing_data_questions: Is the employee permanent or non-permanent?
Which TER category applies?
matrix.notes: rate null by design: PMK 168/2023 uses a TER lookup TABLE, not a scalar. The PDF is archived and hashed but NOT READABLE, so nothing here derives from it. Out of scope for v1 arithmetic.

matrix.label: Marketing / advertising
missing_data_questions: Which enumerated jasa lain item covers this?
Is any part media placement rather than a service?
matrix.notes: PMK 141/2015 item (t) covers making promotional media (film, iklan, poster, banner, baliho, folder). Whether a given marketing invoice falls there is NOT established — rate left null.

matrix.label: Software subscription
missing_data_questions: Is the supplier resident or non-resident? Non-resident may be PPh 26, not PPh 23.
Is this a licence/royalty or a service?
Is PPN-PMSE charged by a foreign provider?
matrix.notes: PMK 141/2015 item (u) covers services relating to software/hardware/computer systems INCLUDING maintenance and repair. A pure licence/subscription may instead be royalty. NOT resolved — rate null.

matrix.label: Equipment / CAPEX
missing_data_questions: Is this goods only, or goods plus installation service?
Is the supplier PKP?
matrix.notes: Goods purchases are generally not PPh 23 objects, but no source was collected to state that. rate null.

matrix.label: Import-related invoice
missing_data_questions: Which customs document evidences this?
Is PPh 22 import collected at the border?
matrix.notes: NO SOURCE COLLECTED for import taxes in this KB. Entirely needs_reviewer.

matrix.label: Loan interest
missing_data_questions: Is the lender a domestic entity, a bank, or non-resident?
Is a tax treaty in play?
matrix.notes: Interest is a Pasal 23(1)(a) object, distinct from the jasa lain regime, and banks are commonly excluded. NO SOURCE COLLECTED — rate null.

matrix.label: Intercompany payment
missing_data_questions: Is the counterparty domestic or foreign?
Is this a service, a royalty, interest, or a capital movement?
Are the parties related for transfer-pricing purposes?
matrix.notes: NO SOURCE COLLECTED. Related-party pricing has its own documentation regime not covered here. Always accountant review.

matrix.label: Mixed invoice
missing_data_questions: Which invoice lines belong to which component?
Is there one agreement or several?
Who is the counterparty for each component?

engine_behaviour.must: This invoice may contain mixed tax treatments. Accountant review required.
engine_behaviour.must_not: Apply a single rate to the whole invoice when mixed components are detected.
engine_behaviour.may: Show the components it believes it has identified, each labelled as a suggestion.

matrix.notes: Grounded in archived text on BOTH sides: PP 34/2017 Pasal 4(2) pulls landlord-billed service charges INTO the 10% rental base even when separately contracted, while DJP_PPH42_006 puts third-party building services at 2% under Pasal 23. A single invoice can therefore legitimately carry two treatments. Splitting is a judgement the engine must not make alone.
